name: hidden-camera-scanner
description: Anti-hidden-camera & suspicious-device scanner: scans Wi-Fi/LAN and Bluetooth to detect covert cameras, surveillance NVRs and unknown trackers (AirTag/SmartTag/Tile etc.), and produces a plain-language risk report.

displayName.zh: 反偷拍与可疑设备扫描

displayDescription.en: Scans Wi-Fi/LAN and Bluetooth to detect hidden cameras, surveillance NVRs and unknown trackers, then delivers a plain-language, compliance-only risk report with phone security check and forensics guidance.
displayDescription.zh: 扫描局域网与蓝牙，发现隐藏摄像头、监控与不明追踪器，生成普通人能看懂的合规风险报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我扫描一下这个网络，看看有没有隐藏摄像头或监控设备
defaultInitPrompt.en: Scan this network for hidden cameras or surveillance devices

quickPrompts.en: Scan this network for hidden cameras or surveillance devices
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我扫描一下这个网络，看看有没有隐藏摄像头或监控设备

quickPrompts.en: Check if there is a tracker like AirTag following me
quickPrompts.zh: 检测一下我周围有没有 AirTag 之类的追踪器

quickPrompts.en: I want to run a phone security check or preserve evidence
quickPrompts.zh: 我想在手机上做安全自查，或者固定维权证据
